candidate_commit_resolution_note: Pin the full SHA in the external G1_C4_COMMIT_MANIFEST.json supplied at handoff. This commit cannot contain its own SHA. Do not resolve a moving branch as the audited SHA.
entrypoint: python -B -m semgrepai (semgrepai.__main__ -> semgrepai.cli:app in prepared fork)

environment_reference_vs_admin_pc.policy: Disclose version differences explicitly in runtime receipts; never alter ADMIN-PC OpenGrep/Ollama installations during acceptance.

changes_in_g1_c2: Derived verified Windows <-> WSL2 `/mnt/<drive>/<rel_source_root>=<source_root>` path mappings strictly from trusted `source_root` in `v2/g1_integration/bridge.py` (plus optional `--path-map` CLI passthrough validated inside `source_root`), eliminating the 11 `POSIX/WSL source path requires an explicit --path-map` failures observed on ADMIN-PC in G1-C1 while preserving `opengrep.json`, `opengrep.sarif`, and `dataflow_trace` 100% lossless.

Hardened `v2/triage/ollama.py` and `v2/triage/heuristics.py` to compare citations, enclosing-method/callee scopes, unreachable dead-branch lines, and wrong-context/invalid sanitizer checks against the Evidence-verified canonical relative path bound to `snapshots` rather than raw `record['path']`.

Added regression and security boundary tests covering valid WSL2 mapping, native Windows paths, pure POSIX mode, arbitrary POSIX paths, cross-drive paths, forged sibling prefixes, `..` traversal, escaping directory junctions/symlinks, SHA-256 mismatches, out-of-scope/dead-branch citations, and invalid-sanitizer `REFUTED` rejections.
changes_in_g1_c3: Exclude raw_path from both snippet producer and whitelist without mutating evidence.
Specify canonical snippet path/hash and exact inclusive multiline quotes; strict validator unchanged.
Replace missing test entrypoint with existing offline suites and detached audit gate; preserve failed G1-C2 lineage.
changes_in_g1_c4: Persist exact same-call HTTP request payload bytes (`llm_io/<id>.request.body.bin`) and bounded HTTP response body bytes (`llm_io/<id>.response.body.bin`, or `.response.incomplete.bin` on truncated/oversize streams) plus `llm_io/<id>.http-capture.json` (`ntk-ollama-http-capture-1`) prior to UTF-8/JSON decoding in `v2/triage/ollama.py`, isolating `/api/tags` under `llm_io/_tags/`, preserving compatibility JSON sidecars, and failing closed (`EVIDENCE_CAPTURE_WRITE_FAILED` -> `UNDETERMINED`, `OPEN` retained, no HTTP retry) on capture write or collision errors.

Add `v2/g1_integration/exec_receipt.py` (binary `.stdout.bin`/`.stderr.bin`/`.receipt.json` + fail-fast exit check), `v2/g1_integration/evaluate_r01_r03.py` (strictly read-only `?mode=ro` SQLite + raw-body validator replay R01-R03 gate), `--auxiliary-controls-only` in `v2/g1_integration/run_g1_demo.py`, and `v2/g1_integration/RUNTIME_ACCEPTANCE_PLAN.md`.
setup_instructions: 1. Pin the full G1-C4 handoff SHA in a separate detached checkout; do not detach the development worktree. Follow v2/g1_integration/RUNTIME_ACCEPTANCE_PLAN.md.
2. Verify or clone clean upstream `https://github.com/hardw00t/simple_semgrepAI.git` checked out at `2c79a58a16d11e9dea3723e30d2a7faffba7bdc9`.

3. Prepare the G1 fork into a fresh private directory outside Git: `python -X utf8 -B -m v2.g1_integration.prepare_g1_fork --upstream <UPSTREAM_DIR> --advisor-dir <PRIVATE_ADVISOR_DIR> --output-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/fork-g1` (or pass `--scanner-layer ntk-cleanroom` if running on a clean server without the private advisor ZIP).
run_instructions: M1 compatibility check (0 LLM calls): `python -X utf8 -B -m semgrepai scan v2/g1_integration/demo_fixtures/Demo1TruePositive.java --rules-path v2/g1_integration/rules/java_g1_cwe22_cwe89.yml --output-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/auxiliary/m1_scan_only --executable <OPENGREP_BIN> --scan-only`

Auxiliary controls Demo3b (SYNTHETIC_MOCK_HTTP) + Demo4 (--no-llm STALE_SOURCE, 0 real Qwen calls): `python -X utf8 -B -m v2.g1_integration.run_g1_demo --prepared-source <PRIVATE_OUT>/fork-g1/source --output-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/auxiliary/controls_suite --executable <OPENGREP_BIN> --auxiliary-controls-only`

Primary G1 integrated local triage (single 4-finding set: Demo1 [2] + Demo2 [1] + Demo3a [1]): `python -X utf8 -B -m semgrepai scan <FIXTURE> --rules-path v2/g1_integration/rules/java_g1_cwe22_cwe89.yml --output-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/primary/<SCENARIO> --executable <OPENGREP_BIN> --local-triage --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:11434 --model qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M --prompt-contract blind --timeout 180`

Raw HTTP capture & protocol verification: `python -X utf8 -B -m v2.triage.verify_http_capture <PRIVATE_OUT>/primary/<SCENARIO>/triage --require-live-chat --minimum-findings <N> --output <PRIVATE_OUT>/audit/<SCENARIO>-http.json` and `python -X utf8 -B -m v2.triage.live_check <PRIVATE_OUT>/primary/<SCENARIO>/triage --minimum-responses <N>`

Human review queue lifecycle (using `.warnings[0].id`): `python -X utf8 -B -m semgrepai queue --db <DB>`, `show <ID>`, `confirm-true <ID> --actor <ACTOR> --reason <REASON>`, `confirm-false <ID> --actor <ACTOR> --reason <REASON>`, `queue --db <DB> --all`, `reopen <ID> --actor <ACTOR> --reason <REASON>`, `history <ID> --include-rejected`

Read-only R01-R03 acceptance evaluation: `python -X utf8 -B -m v2.g1_integration.evaluate_r01_r03 --demo1-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/primary/demo1_true_positive --demo2-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/primary/demo2_protected_fp --demo3a-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/primary/demo3a_missing_helper --m1-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/auxiliary/m1_scan_only --demo3b-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/auxiliary/controls_suite/demo3b_malformed_llm_synthetic_mock --demo4-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/auxiliary/controls_suite/demo4_stale_source --output <PRIVATE_OUT>/audit/r01_r03_evaluation.json`

required_environment.python: >=3.11 with typer, rich, PyYAML (target 3.11.9 isolated venv on ADMIN-PC)
required_environment.opengrep: Local OpenGrep CLI binary (>=1.20.0, native or WSL2 wrapper; advisor reference 1.33.1 vs ADMIN-PC 1.25.0); Semgrep is rejected by design
required_environment.ollama: Local loopback HTTP Ollama at http://127.0.0.1:11434 (advisor reference 0.40.16 vs ADMIN-PC 0.40.7; verify installed model tags via /api/tags; reference model is qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M)

expected_independent_verdict_paths.javis_runtime: Future separately authorized G1-C4 runtime bundle

known_limitations: G1-C2 remains G1_C2_RUNTIME_ACCEPTANCE_FAILED and G1-C3 runtime gate remains RUNTIME_PLAN_REQUIRES_CORRECTION. G1-C4 REAL_OLLAMA and runtime criteria R01-R03 are NOT_TESTED; independent audit and operator approval remain required.

Same-call raw HTTP capture preserves client-sent payload bytes and client-received HTTP response body bytes (`capture_scope: http_body_and_client_metadata_not_tcp_wire`), not raw TCP/chunked wire framing or server-side weight attestation.

Java context extraction is bounded to the enclosing method and same-file helper callees (<=150 lines); cross-file callees are treated as unresolved external calls and fail closed to UNDETERMINED when safety is claimed.
CLI `--actor` is an unauthenticated operator string for local audit trail, and SQLite does not claim OS-level tamper resistance against privileged local users.
Historical G0 findings and 14 pending errata remain untouched and locked (`G0_ACCEPTANCE=CONDITIONAL`, `READY_FOR_G1=CONDITIONAL`, historical Arm C independent contribution `CONFOUNDED`).

offline_test_environment.python: Prefer Python 3.11.9 for ADMIN-PC parity. Development verification uses an isolated Python 3.12.3 AMD64 venv authorized by the operator; Python 3.11.9 parity remains NOT_TESTED.
offline_test_environment.git: Only per-command exact safe.directory allowed for the development worktree; audit helper already supplies per-checkout -c safe.directory. Never change global configuration.
skip_conditions: OpenGrep integration test skips if binary unavailable; no real Ollama is run by these suites.
Live upstream proof skips unless NTK_M1_LIVE_UPSTREAM and NTK_M1_ADVISOR_DIR are supplied; do not access old PRIVATE data.
Symlink test may skip if Windows account cannot create symlinks.
